label: hook_session_start_startup
source: hand-authored: the `q1,q2,q3 --record` run that produced the sibling hook-input fixtures resumed an existing session id, so no fresh 'startup' SessionStart hook ever fired to record. Re-record (by running --record against a fresh session) or hand-update this file on every SDK bump.
